result.boundary: Explicit batches of up to 32 fixed and programmable Nanite raster draws preserve per-draw RDG resources and depth-to-ID phase dependencies. Six Villa A/B view pairs have bit-identical depths and preserved materials, plus both default-scene lifecycle suites. Actual advancing-clock game profiles improve, but Villa performance remains below the ordinary mesh path. Native temporal comparisons and complete Nanite delivery remain open.
